replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a foreign language I struggle to speak fluently. My vocational training focused on practical skills rather than abstract theory, so numbers and formulas often intimidate me. While I appreciate its logic, I prefer subjects like economics or art where creativity plays a bigger role.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure to understand complex equations makes my stomach turn sometimes. My low conscientiousness means I procrastinate on math tasks until the last minute, which only increases my stress levels. It's not that I can't learn, but the anxiety blocks me before I even start.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor recently for some algebra problems. Honestly, it felt a bit impersonal and overwhelming at first. However, once I got used to asking simple questions, it helped break down steps clearly. It didn't cure my anxiety, but it made the process less scary.
